name: William “Billy” McKeldin
sources: Barbara McKeldin Adams, "Barbara McKeldin Adams - A Memoir" (privately printed)

FamilySearch, United States, Social Security Numerical Identification Files (NUMIDENT), 1936-2007 (children of Charles E. McKeldin and Emma V. Bell: Charles Edward McKeldin, 1:1:6K3X-1323; Helen McKeldin Souder, 1:1:6K3X-FZS6; William Henry McKeldin, 1:1:6K3N-QTF8; Lillian May Norris, 1:1:6K3D-FZN3)
notes: Brother of Charles "Buckey" McKeldin, named in his daughter Barbara's memoir; died before she wrote. His sisters called him Billy or Bill. [Barbara McKeldin Adams, A Memoir, text line 392, 4153]
Aged 7 in the 1930 census at 1143 Carroll Street.
His Social Security file gives his full name as William Henry McKeldin, son of Charles McKeldin and Emma Bell; he was named for his grandfather William Henry Bell.
